parameters.content:
## Flow · 1 Intake
POST JSON to /webhook/flow-intake with header **x-flow-key** (the intake_key in flow_settings).
Fields: name, email, company, phone, message, source, website (hidden honeypot, must be empty).

A repeat of the same email and message within dedupe_minutes is acknowledged once and not processed again. Claude sorts each new inquiry; it is saved, you get an alert with a suggested reply and status buttons that expire after token_ttl_days, and the sender gets your acknowledgement. Spam is saved but not answered.
